name: Brilliant Portfolios Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Brilliant Portfolios Ltd is in the business of fund-based financing activity[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
BPL is categorized as a non-deposit taking non-systematically important non-banking finance company. It makes long term and short term investment in quoted and unquoted shares. The company also gives short term and long term loans and is also involved in real estate business.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.26 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 7.27% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 5.96% over last 3 years.
